children: Bidding for Karamtara Engineering Ltd.'s initial public offering (IPO) enters its third and final day on Friday, September11.

Shares of Karamtara Engineering are trading at a grey market premium of ₹69 on the unlisted markets, according to reports. This indicates a potential 27% gain over the upper end of the price band of ₹254 apiece.
It is important to note that GMP data is speculative and the final listing prices could differ from the same.

The ₹875 crore issue was subscribed 3.61 times when bidding closed on the second day on Thursday. Investors cumulatively placed bids for 9.16 crore shares so far, compared to the 2.54 crore shares on offer.

Subscription was led by non-institutional investors, with their overall portion seeing subscription of 6.16 times the total shares on offer. They placed bids for 3.35 crore shares versus the 54.46 lakh shares reserved for them.

Of these NIIs, those who bid in the ₹2 lakh to ₹10 lakh range, led the subscription as their portion was subscribed 7.18 times. These investors have bid on 1.3 crore shares so far while 18.15 lakh were reserved for them.
Corporates, individuals and 'others' bid for 5.64 times the shares reserved for them, by placing bids for to 2.04 crore shares compared to 36.3 lakh shares on offer.
Retail individual investors or those who bid up to ₹2 lakh subscribed to the issue 3.28 times. This translated to them bidding for 4.16 crore shares compared to 1.27 crore shares allotted to them.
Also, qualified institutional buyers (QIB) subscribed to the issue 2.27 times, bidding for 1.65 crore shares compared to the 72.61 lakh allotted to them.

Karamtara Engineering's 875 crore IPO opened for subscription on September 9. The company plans to use around 90% of the 675 fresh issue to repay debt. It had debt of around ₹1,030 crore at the start of the ongoing fiscal.
September 15: Allotment expected to be finalized
September 16 Refunds and credit of shares to demat accounts likely.
September 17: The stock is expected to list the exchanges.

title: Karamtara Engineering IPO GMP: 27% premium in unlisted market points to steady debut; Check other details
